title: L2P prompt pool with Mirror prompt codes
hypothesis: For task families whose useful prompts lie near a shared two-vector orbit, a shared prompt basis plus one angle per retrieved task preserves prompt-conditioned classification quality with fewer serialized bytes than an explicit prompt bank, while any Mirror-specific claim also requires beating the direct two-coefficient basis control.
physical_object: one shared rank-two prompt basis and one frozen feature/readout pair
mirror_coordinate: one persistent angle m_j per retrieved task; prompt_j = cos(m_j) u + sin(m_j) v

model.data: Synthetic continual binary classification. The input contains a noisy task-key vector and an independent Gaussian feature vector. A shared frozen feature map is perturbed by the selected prompt before a shared frozen readout. Teacher decision directions for each world are sampled on a two-dimensional Givens rotation orbit; train/validation/test examples are disjoint. Test-time task identity is not given: all conditions use cosine top-1 retrieval over the same serialized learned key prototypes.

controls: independent explicit trainable prompt per task
shared rank-two basis with two direct coefficients per task
shared rank-two basis with one Givens angle per task (Mirror)
development_gate_before_fresh: Both development seeds: independent prompt accuracy >=0.80; Mirror accuracy within 0.02 absolute of independent; Mirror serialized bytes <=0.60x independent and <=1.10x direct rank-two coefficient control; top-1 retrieval accuracy >=0.98; Mirror exceeds hard-shared prompt accuracy by >=0.05 absolute. All methods use equal examples/updates. Otherwise fresh remains sealed.
success_gate: All three fresh seeds meet quality, retrieval, and byte gates; Mirror beats the matched direct rank-two coefficient control on quality-per-byte or retrieval robustness; deterministic payload reload/replay is exact and runtime/compute overhead is reported.
failure_gate: Either development seed misses any registered quality/storage/retrieval threshold, or the direct coefficient control matches Mirror quality at comparable or lower bytes. Fresh seeds remain sealed.

storage.authority: actual deterministic ZIP/NPY FP16 inference payload after reload
paid_objects: all independent prompt vectors or shared prompt bases
all Mirror angles or direct coefficients
all router key prototypes and retrieval metadata
frozen feature map and readout parameters

boundaries: synthetic aligned prompt-family mechanism screen only
no natural image, continual-learning, or L2P benchmark result is established
retrieved task prompts are not independent capacity merely because four codes exist
development seeds alone may select implementation details; fresh remains sealed unless all development gates pass
